plan: A very mobile fighter who weaves her spells and attacks together to win trades.
aSurveiller: Her Q (Broken Wings). She casts it three times and the 3rd hit knocks you up: back off after the second hit.
contrer: Back off after her second Q: the third knocks you up.
Her W stuns around her: don't stick to her.
Trade when her spells are on cooldown: without them, she has nothing.
forces: Very mobile thanks to her Q and her E.
Her R gives her a ranged strike to finish off.
faiblesses: Weak when her spells are on cooldown.
Hard to play, punishable when she makes mistakes.

sorts.P: Her spells charge her blade: her next attacks hurt more.
sorts.Q: Three chained strikes; the 3rd knocks up.
sorts.E: Dashes forward and gains a shield.
sorts.R: More damage and range, and a ranged strike to finish off.

momentFort: Quiet before level 6. She shines in the mid game: with 1 or 2 items she can take down a target in a single combo.
